annotations.title: Find drillholes by place, owner and type

description: Drillholes (WA open-file and company collars) matching a place and filters: a bbox or a point and radius, and/or a company or project key from search_owners; drilling type groups (dd = diamond core, rc = RC, ac = aircore and RAB, shallow = vacuum, auger, costeans, percussion..., other); a minimum depth; drilled years. Returns the count, counts by hole type and by decade, the deepest holes first (holeid, type, depth, year, operator, project, lon/lat), and a map link showing them. For assays and traces use get_drillhole_traces or sql_query.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees; at most 25 square degrees.

company.description: A company key from search_owners, e.g. "NORTHERN STAR".

project.description: A project key from search_owners, e.g. "jundee".

name: find_drillholes
title: Find drillholes by place, owner and type
